card.name: Small linking words inside repeated passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (the, and, commas, bars) that sit in the middle of a list or a familiar quoted passage. Typical settings are scripture quotes, website link menus, and antiepileptic depression and suicidality warnings.
